title: Rabbi Levanti
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: A student of Rabbi Yonah: in Yevamot, chapter 9, halakhah 8, he asks Rabbi Yonah a question; in Shabbat, chapter 3, halakhah 3, he bathes with Rabbi Yonah; and in Demai, chapter 6, halakhah 7, he reports in Rabbi Yonah’s name.[^1]

notes.text: The checked Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 9:8 names Rabbi Leiontei asking Rabbi Yonah; Shabbat 3:3 names Rabbi Levanti bathing with Rabbi Yonah. These support the senses “asks” and “bathes,” rather than the earlier proposed alternatives “swears” and “anoints.” The reported transmission in Demai 6:7 was not established in the checked section or bounded chapter routing. Hyman’s student relationship and all three locators remain attributed to him, without an identity or teacher binding.
